title: MemorySpacesUnfreezeRequest
description: Reverse of memory.spaces.freeze; always allowed on a frozen space (maintenance allowlist, §8.2). Re-opening a decommissioned cutover source is an operator action that also bumps authority_generation. Grant: admin. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
